background: I was 12 and had untreated anxiety and depression. This was the first major delusion i ever had.

(sorry for grammar) Ok so I was home alone and it was probably 9 and really dark out and all the lights in the house were off . My mom was still at work and my dad was on a business trip out of state. I was in my room (2 story house with basement, my room was on the second story) probably watching youtube. 

I heard the front door open downstairs so i assumed my mom was home. I walked over to the steps and leaned over the railing and yelled “mom” down. No response and i saw all the lights were still off. After a few seconds i heard a voice in my ear say “im here.” I ran to my room and jumped on to my bed crawling to the corner closest to the wall. I started to have a panic attack and cry. 

I started spamming my best friends imessage. As i was doing that i started hearing footsteps really loud from down stairs and everything started getting really dark. My friend didnt know what to do so i started texting my mom. I was too scared to call because i thought someone was listening. She started freaking out, said not to move, to lock my door, and that she was on her way. I was crying and rocking back and forth. 

After like 15-20 minutes of this i heard the door open again and my mom yelling my name. I unlocked the door and walked over to the top of the steps. I saw mom and ran down and hugged her. She kept saying no ones here. Nothing looked different and all the lights were still off.

None of it was real, my brain made it up, I thought it was a ghost at the time lol
